entries.german:
Papst Bonifaz IX. an den Erzbischof von Prag, wegen Ehedispens für Heinrich Ulrich von Rosenberg und Elsabeth, Tochter des Petrus de Crawar. Papež Bonifác IX. povoluje prostrednictvím pražského arcibiskupa, Volframa ze Škvorce, Jindrichovi z Rožmberka, aby uzavrel manželství se svou príbuznou 3. a 4. stupne Eliškou z Kravar.

Siegel: Bleibulle
entries.english:
Pope Boniface IX to the Archbishop of Prague concerning a dispensation from the impediment of consanguinity for the marriage of Heinrich Ulrich von Rosenberg and Elsabeth, daughter of Petrus de Crawar. The Czech text states that Pope Boniface IX, through the Archbishop of Prague, Wolfram of Škvorec, permits Heinrich of Rosenberg to marry his relative Eliška of Kravaře, related to him in the third and fourth degrees.

Seal: Lead bull.
